jp_verse: 静かな工房に　刃物が並び\n\n    職人の息だけが　夜を刻んでいた
en_verse: In the silent workshop the tools lay in order,\nwhile only the craftsman's breath measured the night.

jp_verse: 細い路地に　左への印\n\n    知らない灯りが　奥で揺れていた
en_verse: In the narrow alley a sign pointed left,\nwhere unfamiliar lights flickered in the distance.

jp_verse: 右へ曲がる道に　影が伸び\n\n    古い街並みが　静かに続いていた
en_verse: Along the road turning right, shadows stretched,\nand the old town carried on in silence.

jp_verse: 両手の中に　小さな光\n\n    持つということは　守ることでもあった
en_verse: Within both hands rested a tiny light;\nto possess something was also to protect it.

jp_verse: 暗い部屋で　紙幣が渡され\n\n    言葉にならぬ取引が　夜へ沈んでゆく
en_verse: In the darkened room money changed hands,\nand an unspoken bargain sank into the night.

jp_verse: 捧げられた箱に　金貨が重なり\n\n    人々の敬意が　静かに形となった
en_verse: Coins gathered within the offered chest,\nand the people's respect quietly took form.

jp_verse: 古い書物を　指でなぞりながら\n\n    一つの段落が　時を越えて語りかける
en_verse: Tracing the ancient pages with a finger,\na single paragraph spoke across the years.

jp_verse: 闇の中で　刃がかすかに光り\n\n    触れぬ静けさが　空気を張りつめさせた
en_verse: Within the darkness the sword faintly gleamed,\nand untouched silence tightened the air.

jp_verse: 細い刃先に　冷たい光\n\n    わずかな動きが　運命を分けてゆく
en_verse: Cold light rested upon the blade,\nwhere the slightest movement divided fate.

jp_verse: 黒い裂け目が　夜を断ち切り\n\n    一瞬の光が　静寂を貫いていた
en_verse: A dark incision split the night apart,\nand a single flash pierced the silence.

jp_verse: 差し出された手の向こうに\n\n    甘い闇が　静かに待っていた
en_verse: Beyond the outstretched hand,\na gentle darkness waited in silence.

jp_verse: 森の奥へ　光が差し込み\n\n    立つ人の影が　金色に包まれていた
en_verse: Light poured deep into the forest,\nand the standing figure was wrapped in gold.

jp_verse: 古い法の書に　蝋燭が揺れ\n\n    秤の静けさが　人を見つめていた
en_verse: Candles flickered beside the ancient law,\nwhile the stillness of the scales watched mankind.

jp_verse: 並んで座る二人の間に\n\n    語られぬ力が　静かに流れていた
en_verse: Between the two seated figures,\nunspoken power quietly moved.

jp_verse: 壁を背にして　互いに離れ\n\n    同じ空気だけが　二人を結んでいた
en_verse: Leaning against the wall, they turned apart,\nwhile only the same air connected them.

jp_verse: 暗い空間に　一本の柱\n\n    名もない道が　そこから始まっていた
en_verse: Within the darkness stood a single post,\nand an unnamed street began from there.

jp_verse: 夕暮れの町に　灯りがともり\n\n    人々の声が　窓辺に溶けてゆく
en_verse: Lights awakened throughout the evening town,\nand human voices melted into the windows.

jp_verse: 閉ざされた扉の向こうにも\n\n    小さな道は　静かに続いている
en_verse: Even beyond the closed door,\na small path continued in silence.

jp_verse: 山頂の風に　額を上げれば\n\n    遠い空だけが　静かに広がっていた
en_verse: Lifting one's face to the summit wind,\nonly the distant sky spread in silence.

jp_verse:
幼い手が

    木を重ねながら

    光を見ていた
en_verse: A small pair of hands\nstacked little blocks\nwhile watching the light
